target.title: fix(admin-http-rpc): reject oversized declared request bodies
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Admin HTTP RPC callers could send oversized JSON request bodies and lose the structured 413 response when the request exceeded the 1 MiB route limit.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Admin HTTP RPC handler now rejects oversized declared `Content-Length` values before reading the body and keeps streamed/chunked overflow on a response-safe route-local reader. This preserves the structured 413 response for both transfer modes without changing the RPC allowlist, Gateway authentication, or method dispatch behavior.

## User Impact

Operators and host tooling using `POST /api/v1/admin/rpc` get a clear HTTP 413 JSON response for oversized declared or streamed request bodies, and invalid oversized requests do not reach Gateway RPC dispatch.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: at current head `41b8a302b1c9099a48c6f86cc814a9f9bf66be4c`, Admin HTTP RPC delivers structured HTTP 413 JSON to real Node HTTP clients for declared oversized and streamed/chunked oversized bodies, and `dispatchGatewayMethod` is not called.
- Focused regression: `node scripts\run-vitest.mjs extensions/admin-http-rpc/src/handler.test.ts --reporter=verbose` passed with 1 file and 14 tests, including real HTTP client coverage for both declared and streamed oversized bodies.
- Sibling guard regression: `node scripts\run-vitest.mjs src/infra/http-body.test.ts --reporter=verbose` passed with 1 file and 13 tests.
- Targeted lint: `node_modules\.bin\oxlint.CMD extensions\admin-http-rpc\src\handler.ts extensions\admin-http-rpc\src\handler.test.ts` passed.
- Targeted format: `node_modules\.bin\oxfmt.CMD --check --threads=1 extensions\admin-http-rpc\src\handler.ts extensions\admin-http-rpc\src\handler.test.ts` passed.
- Diff hygiene: `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed; the PR diff against current `upstream/main` remains limited to `extensions/admin-http-rpc/src/handler.ts` and `extensions/admin-http-rpc/src/handler.test.ts`.
- Real behavior proof: GitHub `Real behavior proof` passed on current head `41b8a302b1c9099a48c6f86cc814a9f9bf66be4c`: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29246093361/job/86803242257
